solves.reasoning: (A) an extension of representational skills, (B) when they imitate adults' language, (C) props to support his actions — extension-imitate-support
(A) to represent others, (B) imitating familiar roles, (C) engage in more abstract thinking — represent-familiar-abstract
(A) extension of representational skills, (B) language to communicate, (C) becomes common — representational-communicate-common
원문 'imitate adults' language'가 disregard로 교체됨. 아이는 어른을 모방하지 무시하지 않음 → ③ 부적절
원문 'props to support his actions'가 undermine으로 교체됨. 소품은 행동을 뒷받침하지 약화시키지 않음 → ② 부적절
원문 'becomes common'이 unusual로 교체됨. 추상적 사고 가능 시 판타지 놀이가 흔해짐 → ④ 부적절
doctor kit or kitchen playthings as ___ to support his actions → props(소품)
The child uses ___ and language to communicate → gestures(몸짓)
use a block as a syringe when ___ to be a doctor → pretending(~인 척하다)
imitate = 모방하다 = mimic(흉내 내다)
represent = 나타내다/상징하다 = symbolize
engage in = ~에 참여하다 = participate in
familiar(익숙한)의 반의어 = foreign(낯선). common/similar/typical은 유사어
abstract(추상적인)의 반의어 = concrete(구체적인). theoretical은 유사어
(A) play a role = 역할을 하다, (B) play with friends = 놀다 → (역할을) 하다 - 놀다
'a movement of part of the body ... to express an idea' = gesture(몸짓)
by 뒤에 동명사 필요: imitate → imitating
skills를 수식하는 형용사: represent → representational
able to ___ more abstract thinking → engage in(~에 참여하다). break away/give up/comply 부적합
